analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,377.33) vs SMA5 ($2,417.17)/SMA20 ($2,490.93)/SMA50 ($2,548.29): Below short/mid-term trends, weak positioning.
· Above SMA100 ($2,306.81)/SMA200 ($2,156.01), in mid-long term support zone.
· 52-week position (31.7%): High relative to historical lows, low relative to highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 38.3 → 38.1 (staying neutral): Exited oversold, maintaining neutral zone, lacking directional momentum.
· MACD histogram -24.8268 → -9.7645 (improving): Improvement from weak convergence, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle $2,490.93): Sideways near the middle band, band width at 16.83% indicates contraction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,359.58): Based on 5-day low ($2,358.75), forming a Higher Low pattern.
· Swing resistance ($2,384.47): Near previous high, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day high ($2,522.84) / 5-day low ($2,358.75), 20-day high ($2,738.26) / 20-day low ($2,320.55): Higher Low pattern in progress, sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 0.86: Below 5-day average, reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Neutral RSI, insufficient MACD improvement, and low volume suggest lack of conviction for trend change, maintaining wait-and-see.
